description:
### ✨ New Features

* **Custom branding icon** - badge on the launcher icon so the patched app is distinguishable from an unpatched install.
* **Disable ads** - stops the ad SDK from starting (banner + pre-roll video ads).
* **Enable background playback** - playback continues when the app is not in the foreground.
* **Lift download restrictions** - download videos the app otherwise refuses (uploader-disabled, or longer than six hours).
* **Unlock subscription features** - reports the account as subscribed to the app itself. Anything the server enforces is unaffected.

Compatible with RuTube `31.14.2-rustore`.
